description: Turn a business into reels that all look the same, in plain words, with any AI agent. Your AI agent drafts a Playbook.md with your colors, fonts, logo, and tone, picks one of three reel formats, Explainer, Challenge, or Stage Talk, then drafts the script, caption, and edit brief for owner review.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent implement the requested change with minimal unrelated edits?
Did the agent verify behavior changes instead of relying on intuition?
